notifications.title: main's tests fail, so no agent branch can merge
notifications.detail: generator/tests/test_images.py::test_the_library_photos_are_cut_out fails on main: the photo 'nv1board' (a graphics card, File:Diamond Edge 3D 3400.jpg) in remotion/public/real/credits.json is not a logo and has no face cut-out, and every non-logo photo must have one. A tech video run added it. The auditor's branch was blocked last night for this and tonight's improver branch will be too. No agent may edit remotion/public/real.
notifications.fix: 1. In remotion/public/real/credits.json set "logo": true on the "nv1board" entry (an object is shown as a die-cut sticker, like a logo). 2. Commit to main. 3. Re-run the Agent merge workflow for agent/improver/2026-11-25 (or it merges with tomorrow's branch).

notifications.title: Faster voice is on; channel.json still says 0.92
notifications.detail: Your pace note is applied to every tech Short from tonight: the voice speaks at 1.0 (about 164 words a minute). Agents can't edit channel.json, so the new speed lives in generator/pack.py (OWNER_PACE) and overrides the 0.92 there.
notifications.fix: Optional: set voiceSpeed.short to 1.0 in channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/channel.json so the file matches. Nothing breaks if you leave it.

notifications.title: At 1 Short a day the weekly loop can't reach a verdict
notifications.detail: A test needs 8 Shorts a side (16 Shorts) within 7 days, extended once to 14. This channel makes 1 Short a day, so a test would end after 14 days with 7 a side and no verdict. No Shorts test is started here until it can finish; the next ones are queued (tech-mechanism-by-6s, then your calm-camera note as tech-calm-camera).
notifications.fix: 1. Dashboard → Channels → How Tech Works → Settings. 2. Set Shorts a day to 2 (the daily usage share is 27% now). Or leave it at 1 and the loop waits.
